headline: NNTは基質の結合でdIIIを外し、プロトン通路を切り替える
subhead: 全長の大腸菌NNTを複数の状態で解析。阻害剤パルミトイルCoAはapoに近い状態で固定する
takeaway: NADP(H)が結合するとdIIIが膜ドメインから外れ、プロトン通路の開く向きが反転する

summary.question: 全長の大腸菌NNTの構造と、状態の変化は分かっていなかった。
summary.approach: 全長の大腸菌NNTを、apo・基質結合・阻害剤結合の状態でクライオ電顕で解析した。
summary.result: apoでは2つのdIIIが膜ドメインに張り付き、基質が結合すると外れて通路の向きが変わる。
summary.learned: dIIIの位置が、プロトン通路の開閉と触媒サイクルを左右する。
summary.open: プロトン勾配下のリポソーム再構成で、共役効率を直接調べることが今後必要とされる。

question.quote: Although the structures of isolated (dI)2 and (dI)2(dIII) complexes of E. coli transhydrogenase (EcTH) have been reported,21,31 the architecture and conformational landscape of the full-length enzyme have remained unknown despite extensive biochemical investigation.

approach.quote: Here we present cryo-EM structures of full-length Escherichia coli transhydrogenase in apo, substrate-bound, and inhibitor-bound states.

result.quote: In the apo state, both copies of the NADP(H)-binding domain (dIII) adopt a face-down configuration, with the binding pocket partially embedded in transmembrane domain dII, plugging the cytoplasmic side of the proton channel.

Detachment of dIII from dII allows a conformation compatible with hydride transfer between NADP(H) in dIII and NAD(H) in dI, and is accompanied by conformational changes in the dII proton channel that close periplasmic access and open cytoplasmic access.

learned.quote: These observations indicate that ligand-dependent positioning of dIII regulates access to the proton channel and shapes the catalytic cycle.

open.quote: Future studies using proteoliposome reconstitution under a proton gradient will be required to directly assess the coupling efficiency of the chimera in the forward direction.

highlights.text: dIIIの着脱がプロトン通路の開閉と連動する。さらに外れた2つのdIIIは同時には(dI)2と組まず、片方だけが上向きで寄り添う。二量体の左右で交互にヒドリド転移が進むという触媒サイクルのモデルを提示した。

evidence.quote: Detachment of dIII is associated with rearrangements in the transmembrane helices that form the proton channel, opening toward the cytoplasmic side and closing it on the periplasmic side.
The structures further indicate that two detached dIII domains do not engage (dI)2 simultaneously; only one adopts a (dI)2-associated orientation while the second dIII remains distal.

highlights.text: 阻害剤パルミトイルCoAはdIIIのNADP(H)結合ポケットに入り込み（アデニンのN6がAsp450と水素結合）、dIIIを下向き・膜付着のapo様状態に固定する。生化学で知られていた競合阻害の構造的な根拠になる。

evidence.quote: The N6 atom of the purine ring in palmitoyl-CoA forms a hydrogen bond with the OD1 atom of Asp450, located near the NADP(H)-binding site of dIII
Palmitoyl-CoA is buried within the pocket, partially occupying the position normally taken by NADP(H).

highlights.text: 柔軟で見えにくいdIを捉えるため、βのC末端とαのN末端を原生生物Paratrimastix pyriformis由来のリンカーでつないだ一本鎖変異体を設計。活性は野生型の約1/3を保ち、apoでdIまで含めてモデル化できた。著者はリンカーが動きを制約しうる点も注意している。

evidence.quote: a single-subunit variant was genetically engineered by fusing the two native subunits, α (PntA) and β (PntB), with a linker joining the C-terminus of β to the N-terminus of α
its steady-state turnover rate (kcat) was reduced to 14.3 s−1, approximately 3-fold lower than that of WT EcTH (42 s−1; Figure 1D)
the linker could potentially restrict or bias the movements of dIII relative to dI

lab_notes.expression: pntAB欠損株 C43(DE3) Δcyo ΔpntAB（THO株）にpET16b-EcTHを導入して発現。
lab_notes.construct: N末端Hisタグ付き。野生型と、β–リンカー–αの一本鎖融合体（102 kDa）。
lab_notes.purification: LMNGで可溶化し、IMAC → サイズ排除クロマトグラフィー。
lab_notes.sample_prep: Quantifoil R 2/1 金グリッド（300メッシュ）、Vitrobot Mark IV 8°C・湿度100%、ブロット2.5–4秒。阻害剤は1 mMで事前に添加。
lab_notes.data_collection: Titan Krios＋Gatan K3（カウンティングモード）。

evidence.quote: The pntAB knockout strain (THO, C43(DE3) Δcyo ΔpntAB), in which the pnt genes were replaced by a chloramphenicol resistance gene, was transformed with the pET16b-EcTH plasmid
Recombinant proteins with N-terminal His-tags were purified in LMNG detergent using immobilized metal-affinity chromatography followed by size-exclusion chromatography.

For each sample, 3 μl was applied to a freshly glow-discharged 300-mesh Quantifoil R 2/1 gold grid and blotted for 2.5–4 s with a blotting force of −4 at 8°C and 100% humidity in a FEI Vitrobot Mark IV (Thermo Fisher).
the single-subunit EcTH was incubated with 1 mM palmitoyl-CoA prior to cryo-EM grid preparation
